newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $2 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to Monday's close, USDA said. Feeder heifers were steady to $2.00 higher.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 68.50-74.50, including 31 head 664 lbs 73.00; 700-800 lbs 63.00-70.40; 800-900 lbs 63.50-67.00, including 23 head 806 lbs 67.00. Medium and Large 2 500- 600 lbs 71.50-72.00. Holsteins - 600-700 lbs 48.50-57.75; pen 799 lbs 48.25.
Feeder Heifers - 600-700 lbs 59.25-64.70,including 19 head 676 lbs 64.70. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs 59.00-60.50. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,000
